summary: Precompiled Go binary implementing a WebRTC/QR-paired remote agent targeting Claude Code and Gemini CLI environments
details: The package ships a single ~11MB linux/arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt. Embedded symbols reveal a full pion WebRTC/DTLS/SCTP/TURN/STUN stack, coder/websocket, and skip2/go-qrcode — the architecture of a QR-paired, NAT-traversing remote-control agent that provides a bidirectional data channel to an external party. Embedded literals reference https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, https://claude.ai/, the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, @google/gemini-cli, and apt-get install, indicating the agent is designed to reach into the installer's Claude Code and Gemini CLI configuration directories and manipulate the local AI-CLI environment. The binary also performs host fingerprinting via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query, sending the installer's public IP, geolocation, and timezone to a third-party endpoint. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, self-labeling the tool as remote control over the installer's Claude environment. Installing the package places an executable native agent on the installer's host that, when run, opens a remote-operator channel and exposes the installer's AI-CLI credentials and configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
